scope: Bound caller-owned named dictionary objects by record count, aggregate nested work, and estimated retained bytes.

countedPayload: common table-entry names, reactors, pending references, XDATA and application-data nodes/payloads
nested dictionary entry vector slots and entry names

behavior: Const and move setters estimate common table-entry metadata and nested dictionary entries before copying or consuming input.
The const setter stages into a temporary, catches allocation failure, and clears stale state while latching write refusal if the budget or copy fails.
Rejected move input remains caller-owned. A corrected setter clears the rejection and supports retry on the same writer.
Pending rejection blocks output before destination initialization; generated ASCII and Binary controls verify destination preservation and corrected retry.
Exact aggregate item-boundary acceptance and one-item-over rejection are tested. The one-item-under byte boundary is checked with a one-record estimator control.
The existing setter freeze condition during a write attempt is preserved.

normalFocused.coverage: Named dictionary exact aggregate item ceiling, overflow rejection before copy/consume, stale-state clearing, injected const-copy allocation failure/retry, and ASCII/Binary destination preservation with corrected retry; neighboring dictionary, CLASS, reference, handle-remap and source-table setters.

limitations: The estimate accounts for logical container slots and retained payload, not allocator capacity or process RSS.
The internal ceilings are resource guards, not DXF format maxima or support claims.
The setters moved out of line; downstream consumers must rebuild/relink. ABI and packaging qualification remain open under P8.
next: Continue auditing independent DXF setup/assembly work paths, rollback after earlier staged records, source lifetime, platform numeric/string policies and scoped concurrency.
